name: Dofollow.Tools

sources.title: Homepage — live AI/SaaS directory (~950 listings), shows own traffic: ~3.2k visitors/30 days
Submit form — 2-step wizard; URL auto-fill, tagline ≤160 chars, description ≥500 chars markdown, logo upload, up to 4 screenshots, ≤3 categories
Pricing — Free (badge + 7-day queue + 5 slots/day), Pro $19 lifetime, Dual $25.90 (with firstlook.tools), Featured $99

conditions: Free listing requires embedding a 'Featured on Dofollow.Tools' badge on your site and keeping it live
Badge is re-checked regularly — removing it downgrades your link to nofollow
Free submissions wait 7 days in a review queue, capped at 5 free slots per day site-wide
requirements: Tool URL (form has AI auto-fill), Tool Name, Tagline ≤160 chars, Description ≥500 chars in markdown
Logo file (PNG/JPG/WEBP/SVG, max 500KB) and up to 4 screenshots (<5MB each)
Pick up to 3 categories, pricing model, and platforms
Optional fields: discount code, founded year, YouTube demo, GitHub repo, founder Twitter, affiliate program
Paid tiers: Pro $19 lifetime (skip queue, permanent dofollow), Dual $25.90 (also lists on firstlook.tools), Featured $99
preparation: Write a 500+ character markdown description and a ≤160-char tagline
Prepare logo and up to 4 screenshots
For free tier: ability to embed their badge (dark/light/transparent embeds provided)
An account (Sign In) to access the submit wizard
workflow: Step 1: paste tool URL, click the AI auto-fill button, then refine name/tagline/description, upload logo + screenshots, pick ≤3 categories, pricing model, platforms
Step 2: choose submission type — Free (badge + queue) or a paid lifetime tier
Free listings go live after the ~7-day queue; paid go live in minutes
watchFor: Free link is dofollow only while the badge stays up — they re-crawl for it
5 free slots/day cap means the free queue can stall; not a same-day play
Description minimum is 500 chars — thin copy gets rejected at the form
Self-reported traffic is small (~3.2k visits/30d) — this is a backlink play, not an audience
Built on the Nexty.dev directory template — many sister sites share the same mechanics
countsAsLive: The tool has a public detail page on dofollow.tools appearing in its category and the Latest/Explore listings
unknowns: Whether the badge placement is verified before the 7-day queue starts
DR claim (70+) is self-reported via a FrogDR badge
Whether featured listings' '1000+ page' dofollow claim refers to tag/category page propagation
